1.

The instant petition has been filed praying for a mandamus directing respondent no. 2 to consider
and decide the objection of the petitioners dated 21.04.2023 and release the compensation amount
in respect of Arazi No. 15, village Chakmeer Fazal Ali, Pargana Arail, Tehsil Karchhana, District
Prayagraj.
2.  It is evident from the documents placed on record that the respondents had issued a notification under Section 3-A of National Highways Act, 1956.

Thereafter, notification under Section 3-C was Ramdhari @ Ram Dhari Bhartiya And 4 ... vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/40412078/
1 issued followed by award dated 22.11.2022.

entities.text: Ramdhari @ Ram Dhari Bhartiya And 4 ... vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The objection of the petitioners is for award of a higher compensation amount.
It has been filed before the Special Land Acquisition Officer, Prayagraj.

3. Section 3G(5) of the National Highways Act, 1956 provides that if the amount determined by the Competent Authority under sub-section (1) or sub-section (2) is not acceptable to either parties, the amount shall, on an application by either of the parties, be determined by the Arbitrator to be appointed by the Central Government.

4. Therefore, the petitioners have efficacious remedy to challenge the award and claim higher compensation in the manner provided under the Act.
5.
No good ground is made out to direct the Special Land Acquisition Officer, Prayagraj to decide the objections.
6. Accordingly, the petition is dismissed with liberty to avail the remedy provided under the Act.
